## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite flow still accepts passwords shorter than twelve characters, so this change does not fully apply the new twelve-character policy. That gap should be fixed.

## Changes
This pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py` and moves the boundary tests in `tests/test_signup.py` and `tests/test_reset.py` to 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH in app/invite.py to 12 — A 9-character password submitted through the invite flow is still accepted: `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, while this line and `app/reset.py:1` now require 12. The PR body says the change "raises the minimum in the password validators," but the invite validator is not changed. — Accounts created from invites can still have 8 to 11 character passwords, which breaks the security policy this pull request is meant to enforce. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and update `tests/test_invite.py:6-8` to the same 11/12/13 boundaries used in `tests/test_signup.py`; consider one shared constant so the three validators cannot drift apart again.
